secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key used to email contact-form submissions to CONTACT_TO_EMAIL. Create at https://resend.com/api-keys after verifying the sending domain.

secrets.name: CONTACT_RETRY_TOKEN
secrets.description: Shared secret required by POST /api/contact/retry to re-send notifications for inquiries whose email delivery failed. Any long random string.
